title: Vibe Coding vs Traditional Coding: What's the Real Difference?
summary: Vibe coding vs traditional coding: honest comparison of speed, control, use cases, and when each approach makes sense. Plus how to combine both.
body_markdown: No-code tools give you a fixed set of building blocks with defined constraints — Webflow's visual grid, Airtable's data model, Zapier's trigger-action patterns. Vibe coding generates arbitrary code from natural language prompts, so you're not limited to pre-built components. The upside is more flexibility. The downside is that the output is actual code, which means it can break in ways that constrained no-code tools don't.[Blink](https://blink.new/) bridges both: AI-generated apps with a structured production environment that handles the infrastructure complexity.
